headline: Full Stack Developer (React, Node.js)
summary: Full stack developer with four years of experience shipping web applications for logistics and online-retail clients. I build React front ends and Node.js services on MySQL, and I write automated checks as part of every feature rather than after it. I work comfortably in two-week sprints and like untangling production bugs.

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Led the build of a shipment-tracking dashboard in React and Node.js for a trucking client that handles about 300 bookings a day.
Reworked MySQL indexes on the booking tables; the slowest dispatch report went from 40 seconds to under 3.
Introduced Cypress end-to-end suites for checkout and booking flows, roughly halving bugs reported after each release.
Tracked down a memory leak in the Node.js API with heap snapshots in Chrome DevTools.
